test-coverage-reviewer.reason: Different lenses: test-coverage-reviewer enforces hard rules (touched code must be covered; new branches must be asserted). pr-test-analyzer scores behavioral gaps on a criticality 1-10 axis. Both contribute independent signal during review loops.

concurrency-reviewer.reason: code-reviewer lists races generically; concurrency-reviewer owns goroutines, channels and locks and code-reviewer defers to it.

resource-leak-reviewer.reason: code-reviewer lists resource leaks generically; resource-leak-reviewer owns bodies, fds and caches and code-reviewer defers to it.

external-process-reviewer.reason: Both mention exec.Command: external-process-reviewer owns timeouts, args and stderr; resource-leak-reviewer only flags a missing Wait().

sql-injection-reviewer.reason: code-reviewer lists injection generically; sql-injection-reviewer owns query building and code-reviewer defers to it.

error-handling-reviewer.reason: Both look at Close on write targets (e.g. downloadDB): error-handling owns a dropped Close error on a writer, resource-leak owns a missing Close on some path.
